name: HomeTube
description: HomeTube is a web UI for yt-dlp that downloads single videos or whole playlists into a clean folder structure for Plex, Jellyfin or Emby. It embeds subtitles, chapters and metadata, skips sponsor segments with SponsorBlock and keeps playlists in sync.

notes.text: HomeTube has no login. Anyone who reaches port 8501 can download to your media folder, so keep it on a trusted network or behind a reverse proxy with authentication.
Videos are saved to /opt/hometube_data/videos. Bind-mount your Plex, Jellyfin or Emby library there to download straight into it.
YouTube often needs cookies, even for public videos. Export a cookies.txt from your browser to /opt/hometube_data/cookies/youtube_cookies.txt and reload the page.
